'''Eric Bailey Bailey's Ewoks''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Eric Bailey]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls136.htm Bailey's Ewoks], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027134739/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls136.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
